theme_cn: 一般现在 / 现在进行时 + 时间介词 + KET 词汇（Exercise02）+ 方位介词作文 + 听力
grammar_name: 语法 · 一般现在时 vs 现在进行时 + in / on / at
listening_name: 听力 · 此刻正在做什么
writing_name: 背诵作文 · 写给 Lucy 的房间方位信
spell_name: 今天的 KET 重点词，敲一遍

grammar.question: Jack ___ football every weekend.
grammar.explanation_cn: every weekend 是习惯，用一般现在时第三人称单数 plays（图1 Grammar 第 1 题）。

grammar.question: My sister ___ a fashion show on TV this evening.
grammar.explanation_cn: this evening 指此刻正在进行的安排，用现在进行时 is watching（图1 第 4 题）。

grammar.question: We ___ three bedrooms in our house.
grammar.explanation_cn: have 表示「拥有」是状态动词，不用进行时（图1 第 3 题）。

grammar.question: Do you ___ where I can buy some cool trainers?
grammar.explanation_cn: know 是状态动词，一般疑问句用 Do you know（图1 第 8 题）。

grammar.question: 选词填空（in / on / at）：Let's have lunch together ___ noon.
grammar.explanation_cn: at noon 在中午，具体时间点用 at（图2 第 8 题）。

grammar.question: 选词填空（in / on / at）：The Spring Festival is ___ January 1st in the Chinese lunar calendar.
grammar.explanation_cn: 具体日期 January 1st 前用 on（图3 综合练习二第 1 题）。

grammar.question: 选词填空（in / at / on）：Tom told me his parents had arrived ___ Beijing.
grammar.explanation_cn: 到达大城市用 arrive in；arrive at 后接机场、车站等小地点（图4 三选一第 2 题）。

listening.question: Listen to the dialogue. What is Tom doing at the moment?
listening.audio_text: Girl: Tom, what are you doing at the moment? Boy: I am sitting in the living room and playing computer games. Girl: Mum is cooking supper in the kitchen.
listening.explanation_cn: 男孩说 I am … playing computer games（正在玩电脑游戏）；做饭的是妈妈。

listening.question: Listen to the dialogue. Who is cooking supper tonight?
listening.audio_text: Boy: Dad usually cooks supper, but he is working late today. Woman: Yes, I am cooking our supper tonight. Boy: It smells great!
listening.explanation_cn: usually cooks 的是爸爸，但今晚 is cooking 的是妈妈，问 tonight 要听后半句。

listening.question: Which picture matches the sentence you hear?
listening.audio_text: At the moment the two children are having a snack in the living room.
listening.explanation_cn: 句子里说 having a snack（吃零食），所以选饼干 🍪。

listening.question: Listen and fill in the blank: My brother and I are ___ our favourite computer games.
listening.audio_text: My brother and I are playing our favourite computer games.
listening.explanation_cn: 听到 are playing our favourite computer games，填 playing。

ket_pet.question: KET: a room for sleeping in → ___
ket_pet.explanation_cn: 睡觉的房间是 bedroom；bathroom 是洗澡的房间（图4 连线题）。

ket_pet.question: KET: I made an ___ with Mark to go fishing on Saturday.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: make an appointment with sb. 和某人约好，是固定搭配（图4 三选一第 1 题）。

ket_pet.question: KET: Uncle Lee usually spends his summer holiday in the rural ___.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: rural area 乡村地区，是固定说法（图4 三选一第 3 题）。

ket_pet.question: KET 改错：She's liking the clothes she bought. 正确的动词形式是 ___
ket_pet.explanation_cn: like 是状态动词不用进行时；主语第三人称单数用 likes（图1 改错第 1 题）。

ket_pet.question: KET 隐藏词：Beijing Roast Duck is famous ___ the world.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: around the world 全世界，是固定搭配（图4 隐藏词填空第 6 题）。

writing.title: Dear Lucy（方位介词小作文 · 全文背默）
writing.requirement_cn: 先把整封信读三遍，再把 5 个方位介词填回去，最后背诵全文。五个空全是这一周练的方位介词！
writing.template: Dear Lucy, My bed is {{1}} the window and the desk. A big map hangs {{2}} my bed. The small bookcase stands {{3}} the door. My football is {{4}} the chair. Please come and sit {{5}} me this Sunday! Yours, Amy
writing.full_text_cn: 亲爱的Lucy，我的床在窗户和书桌之间。一张大地图挂在我的床上方。小书柜立在门后面。我的足球在椅子下面。这个星期天来坐在我旁边吧！你的Amy
writing.explanation_cn: 书信三件事：称呼 Dear Lucy、正文用方位介词说清每样东西在哪儿、结尾邀请加署名。between A and B 只管两个；above 高于且不接触；behind 在后面；under 在正下方；beside 紧挨着。
writing.explanation_en: A short letter needs a greeting (Dear Lucy), clear place words (between, above, behind, under, beside), and a closing with your name.

spell.question: 约定：a__________ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: make an appointment with sb. 和某人约好。

spell.question: 漂亮的：b________ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: beau + ti + ful；a beautiful hat 一顶漂亮的帽子（图4 隐藏词）。
